purpose: Programme ledger for the Remote Browser work items of §41. It is NOT the repository-wide maturity authority: evidence/van-system-audit/component_ledger.json remains that, and §40.3 constrains what a row here may claim about a component there. A row can never force a stronger terminal state than the component ledger records.
booleans_note: §40.6 calls these nine and lists eight. Eight is what a row carries: built, wired, reachable, live, verified, observed, recoverable, certified. The ninth in §0's execution contract is DESIGNED, which this document itself satisfies for every row.
